question: Two electric bulbs rated $P_1$ watt, $V$ volt and $P_2$ watt, $V$ volt are connected in parallel across a voltage supply $V$. If $P_1 > P_2$, which bulb will glow brighter?

options.C: Both will glow with equal brightness.
options.D: Depends on the resistance of the wires.
